newsitem.title: USA: Unimed drug set for trial with AIDS group.
newsitem.headline: Unimed drug set for trial with AIDS group.

text.p: Unimed Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday that the AIDS Clinical Trials Group will conduct a Phase II/III placebo-controlled study of nitazoxanide to treat AIDS patients with cryptosporidiosis.
Cryptosporidiosis is a condition caused by a microscopic protozoan parasite. Symptoms include profuse diarrhea, abdominal cramping, severe dehydration and weight loss.
The AIDS Clinical Trials Group is a cooperative supported by the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases.
Nitazoxanide is a nitrothiazole benzamide compound that acts against a number of protozoan and parasitic worms. A Phase II trial of the drug was recently completed with promising results.
The new six-week test is expected to start by the end of 1996.
